Bitcoin's BIP-110 soft-fork deadline arrives amid low miner support, raising fork risk –
Link
Bitcoin's contested BIP-110 "spam filter" proposal reaches its mandatory enforcement block around 961,632, expected Aug 7-8. Matters because: Even a low-probability chain-split risk could pressure short-term BTC liquidity and trigger temporary volatility.
